build_unet_args: build argument parser defaults for a UNet MRI reconstruction model with data and trainer config
build_varnet_args: build argument parser defaults for a VarNet MRI reconstruction model with cascades and sensitivity params
test_unet_trainer: test the UNet PyTorch Lightning trainer with mock MRI dataset and k-space mask transforms
test_varnet_trainer: test the VarNet PyTorch Lightning trainer with mock MRI dataset and equispaced mask transforms
create_mask_for_mask_type: create a k-space undersampling mask function using random or equispaced acceleration strategy
